chapter.nerofactions.standing.title: Standing Among the Stars
quest.nerofactions.standing.behind_the_c: Anyone can build a Faction Trade Terminal; standing is what it takes to trade at one. Put up your counter and see who comes calling.
quest.nerofactions.standing.free_colonis: The Free Colonists have counted you among their own inner circle. Somewhere out there, a patchwork flag has a new stitch in it.
quest.nerofactions.standing.miner_union_: The Miner Union's inner circle has opened its ranks to you. The hands that dig the worlds remember who stood with them.
quest.nerofactions.standing.nero_corpora: Nero Corporation's inner circle has taken a seat for you at the long black-and-gold table. Mind the margin.
quest.nerofactions.standing.salvagers_ci: The Salvagers have welcomed you into their inner circle. Every wreck between here and the rim is now a little more yours.
quest.nerofactions.standing.space_guild_: The Space Guild's inner circle has filed your name on the charts. The void belongs to those who do the paperwork, and now you are one of them.
quest.nerofactions.standing.terraforming: The Terraforming Authority has brought you into its inner circle. Somewhere a dead rock is a century closer to a garden.
quest.nerofactions.standing.void_cult_ci: The Void Cult's inner circle has drawn you close. The dark between the stars was listening, and it seems to have heard your name.
quest.nerofactions.standing.sworn_in.des: Pick a side. Pledge yourself to a faction with /nerofactions join and they will send you their colours to fly.
quest.nerofactions.standing.open_for_bus: Make your first trade at a Faction Trade Terminal. Members only; the goods are your faction's specialities and every sale earns standing.
quest.nerofactions.standing.free_colonis: You have joined the Free Colonists. No charter, no landlord, and a patchwork flag that is now partly yours.
quest.nerofactions.standing.miner_union_: You have joined the Miner Union. Dues are paid in sweat and ore, and the Union looks after its own.
quest.nerofactions.standing.nero_corpora: You have joined Nero Corporation. Read the contract. Then read the small print under the contract.
quest.nerofactions.standing.salvagers_me: You have joined the Salvagers. Everything that is not bolted down is inventory, and the bolts are negotiable.
quest.nerofactions.standing.space_guild_: You have joined the Space Guild. Your name is on the manifest; the charts and the paperwork come later.
quest.nerofactions.standing.terraforming: You have joined the Terraforming Authority. Every garden starts with someone willing to haul the soil.
quest.nerofactions.standing.void_cult_me: You have joined the Void Cult. The dark between the stars has your name now; try not to think about that too hard.
quest.nerofactions.standing.word_gets_ar: Somewhere on this server, a faction has taken notice of a newcomer for the first time. The factions are watching now.
quest.nerofactions.standing.server_first: For the first time on this server, a faction has opened its inner circle to someone. History will note the day, if not the name.
